blocked.name: Siren Stormtamer
blocked.why: 'Counter target spell or ability that targets you or a creature you control': no target that is a spell or an ability, filtered on what it targets.

blocked.name: The Darkness Crystal
blocked.why: The death replacement also gains 2 life, and its cards are 'exiled with' the Crystal for the last ability; the exile-instead replacement has neither.

blocked.name: Wheel of Misfortune
blocked.why: Each player secretly chooses a number, revealed together.

blocked.name: Mount Doom
blocked.why: 'Sacrifice Mount Doom and a legendary artifact' and 'choose up to two creatures, then destroy the rest'.

blocked.name: Forge Anew
blocked.why: Equip at instant speed on your turn, and the first equip each turn for {0}.

blocked.name: Turntimber Symbiosis // Turntimber, Serpentine Wood
blocked.why: The chosen creature enters with three more +1/+1 counters if its mana value is 3 or less: counters as it enters, not after.

blocked.name: Dreamtide Whale
blocked.why: Vanishing needs a 'when the last time counter is removed' trigger.

blocked.name: Lost Monarch of Ifnir
blocked.why: Afflict now exists (helpers.afflict); the second-main trigger's 'if a player was dealt combat damage by a Zombie this turn' doesn't.

blocked.name: Perplex
blocked.why: Transmute exists (helpers.transmute); 'unless its controller discards their hand' is no unless option.

blocked.name: Skrelv's Hive
blocked.why: Corrupted and the Mite token exist; 'creatures you control with toxic' has no filter.

blocked.name: Danny Pink
blocked.why: Mentor exists; the granted 'for the first time each turn' counters trigger doesn't (once per turn isn't the same: it counts events from before the ability was there).

blocked.name: Blightsteel Colossus
blocked.why: Infect exists; 'if it would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, shuffle it into its owner's library instead' doesn't.

blocked.name: Great Train Heist
blocked.why: Spree exists; 'if it's your combat phase' and a this-turn trigger keyed to the chosen opponent don't.

blocked.name: Lively Dirge
blocked.why: Spree exists; 'up to two creature cards with total mana value 4 or less' doesn't.

blocked.name: Collective Effort
blocked.why: Escalate is mana only; this one taps an untapped creature.

blocked.name: Pride Sovereign
blocked.why: Exert exists as an effect and an as-it-attacks choice, not as an activation cost.

blocked.name: Cloud's Limit Break
blocked.why: Tiered exists; 'any number of target tapped creatures with different controllers' doesn't.

blocked.name: Tifa's Limit Break
blocked.why: Tiered exists; doubling and tripling a creature's P/T (signed, negative power included) doesn't.

blocked.name: Minas Morgul, Dark Fortress
blocked.why: Shadow is a keyword counter (rule 122.1b); 'a Wraith for as long as it has a shadow counter' isn't expressible.

blocked.name: The Master, Multiplied
blocked.why: Myriad exists; 'triggered abilities you control can't cause you to sacrifice or exile creature tokens' and the tokens' legend-rule exemption don't.

blocked.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
blocked.why: Boast exists; 'can boast twice' and mana that stays until end of turn don't.
